trade_query: id>479129 AND id<=frontier ORDER BY id LIMIT 5000; filter version and created_at>=boundary
limitations: No whole-history rescan; old SYNTHESIS and ROUND2 observations remain historical.
Terminal PnL across arms is a diagnostic repeated-exposure sum, not one portfolio.
Post-entry outcomes never become earlier decision features.
No post-exit path quotes fetched; early exit versus later crash only assessed through matched cohort controls.
Account snapshots are latest cumulative period evidence and can precede/follow the frozen trade cutoff; they are not clean post-boundary returns.
Only positions with a trade in the post-boundary window are included; old idle open positions are represented only in account snapshots.
